title: REACT – Rapid Emergency Allocation Using Cognitive Technology
tagline: Research paper presented at ICCIS, BITS Pilani Goa
summary: AI-powered disaster resource recommendation system that combines a Random Forest model with a Linear Programming pipeline to optimise the dispatch of medical supplies across disaster-affected zones in Uttarakhand.

title: AI Music Composition using LSTM
summary: Trained an LSTM with an Attention layer on the Bach MIDI dataset. Converted MIDI files into note sequences and generated new compositions back in MIDI format.

title: Netflix Content Analytics Dashboard
summary: Deployed a Streamlit dashboard that analyses 8,000+ Netflix titles with real-time filters for year, genre and type, using Pandas for cleaning and preprocessing.

title: JSON-to-SQL Data Pipeline
summary: Python scripts that parse large JSON files and auto-generate SQL INSERT and UPDATE queries at scale, imported into Google Cloud SQL through Cloud Storage for a live credit card rewards system.
